requirements.requirement: The system must include a 'board_certification' object in the provider evaluation response payload returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate the 'board_certification' object using the scoring output produced by the core logic implemented in EVAL-BOARD-ST-002.
The system must preserve the schema structure defined in EVAL-BOARD-ST-001 when exposing board certification data in the facade response.
The system must include at minimum the fields certifications, relevance_score, and confidence in the board_certification object if available.
The system must include the board_certification measure alongside other provider evaluation measures without removing or altering existing fields in the response payload.
The system must ensure the board_certification data is serializable and compatible with downstream JSON consumers.
The system must return a null or empty board_certification object when no certification data is available instead of omitting the field.
The system must not throw an error if the board certification scoring logic returns missing or partial fields.
The system must gracefully handle failures in upstream board certification scoring by returning the provider evaluation response without the board_certification data populated.
The system must ensure that inclusion of board_certification does not increase the response latency of evaluate_care_facade beyond acceptable existing thresholds.
The system must expose board_certification data in a consistent location within the response payload for all provider evaluations.
The system must ensure that downstream consumers (e.g., chat/UI) can access the board_certification field without additional transformation logic.
